is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae s.s. and An. coluzzii) in Côte d'Ivoire.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr-west), Vgsc L995S (kdr-east), and Ace-1 G280S (ace-1R) in Table 2.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 provides genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) and allele frequencies for L995F, L995S, and G280S for three populations.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected as larvae from field sites in Gagnoa, Daloa, and Abengourou, Côte d'Ivoire, and reared to adulthood.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original research article reporting new field data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies three districts: Abengourou, Daloa, and Gagnoa, and provides coordinates for each in the Methods section.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Larvae were collected in July 2020, and the study was published in 2024.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new collection of mosquitoes in July 2020 for the purpose of this specific research.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and bioassay results, are provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the susceptibility of field-collected Anopheles gambiae s.l. from three districts in Côte d'Ivoire (Gagnoa, Daloa, Abengourou) to various insecticides, including clothianidin and chlorfenapyr. It also genotyped 150 mosquitoes for kdr-west (L995F), kdr-east (L995S), and Ace-1 (G280S) mutations.
